title: agentic-workflow document provenance stamp v1
description: The parsed value of a document's `doc-provenance@1` block (issue #462): which tool and schema version wrote it, which carrier format it speaks, and which grammar generations its content declares. Three axes, never merged. Source of truth: @gtrabanco/agentic-workflow-schema (src/doc-provenance.ts). The carried block is the fenced `doc-provenance@1` text form; this schema describes its parsed object, which is what `validateDocProvenance` judges.

written_by.description: The forensic half's writer: `<tool>@<train-version>`, the tool from the published writer set.

schema.description: The forensic half's schema package: the version whose grammar table the writer spoke.

format.description: The carrier layout generation the document was written under — the axis a major re-cut rewrites wholesale.

grammars.description: The content grammars the document declares: closed family keys, integer generations, at least one.
